binary_difference: The release adds an early decline for linked multi-node devices. The single-node comparison binary is preserved as measured/measured-probe.dll. Release confirmation and native tests are included.
vendor_distribution: Vendor host/assets excluded. Rebuild the official pinned SDK with the checked-in host adapter; each run pins the exact host hash.
verdict: Engine-independent GPU cost capture and shader identification validated. No shader/quality changes, FPS optimization or 2x claim.
